contract: Prismworks column C, 69% free ground: the seam at full size east of the mouth, and a raked bank you climb to look down into it over the gallery's own parapet.

role_contracts.construction: legal states, supported placements, stable components, and an auditable bill of materials
role_contracts.path: continuous traversable route with supported furnishings and deliberate access

brief.narrative: The crystal seam at full size on the far side of the well's mouth, and a raked bank of three benches climbing away from it, so a guest can look down into the shaft over the rim gallery's own parapet.

fun_contract.outcome: The east half of Prismworks stops being lawn between a hole and a railway.
